definitions.explanation: Physical impact between two objects, especially vehicles.
Disagreement or opposition between people, groups, or ideas.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}が{壁|かべ}に{衝突|しょうとつ}した。
examples.english: The car collided with the wall.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}の{意見|いけん}が{衝突|しょうとつ}している。
examples.english: The opinions of the two countries are in conflict.

examples.japanese: {正面|しょうめん}{衝突|しょうとつ}で{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{負傷|ふしょう}した。
examples.english: Many people were injured in the head-on collision.

notes:
{衝突|しょうとつ}する is used as a する-verb for both physical collisions and abstract conflicts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正面|しょうめん}{衝突|しょうとつ} (head-on collision)
- {衝突|しょうとつ}を{避|さ}ける (to avoid a collision/conflict)
- {意見|いけん}の{衝突|しょうとつ} (clash of opinions)
- {利害|りがい}の{衝突|しょうとつ} (conflict of interest)
- {衝突|しょうとつ}{事故|じこ} (collision accident)
